snippet.title: Pegs Of Hell | Launch Trailer #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #pachinko #pegsofhell
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073610/Pegs_of_Hell/

The gates of Hell's casino will open on 17th November 2026. Pegs of Hell is a physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.
